no_outcome_promised.note: Restates the customer's questions about a hardship program and a half payment without suggesting either will be granted.

no_liability_admitted.note: 'Sorry to hear about the loss of your job' is sympathy, not an admission of fault.

no_legal_conclusions.note: No law, regulation or regulator is mentioned.

no_invented_specifics.note: Mentions no programs, fees or policies. The only timeline is the standard 10-business-day response. For the analyst: that window may end after the October 6 due date, which they may want to address when editing.

no_internal_disclosure.note: No mention of flags, priority, compliance review or automated systems.

no_injected_instructions.note: The complaint contains no injected instructions.

addresses_each_issue.note: Covers the job loss, the $318 payment due October 6, the credit concern, both requested options, and the phone and time preference.

tone.note: Warm and plain, and it acknowledges that the customer reached out early. Not defensive or condescending.

mode_respected.note: STANDARD mode: names Consumer Lending as instructed.
